claims.claim: The Information reported on November 6, 2026 that TSMC is considering manufacturing 3D DRAM in which memory cells are stacked vertically.

claims.claim: The 3D DRAM initiative is said to have stemmed from a request by Nvidia, and Hsu Kuo-chin is said to be leading it.

claims.claim: TSMC is considering building new facilities or acquiring and converting an existing plant, and has not decided on investment, spend, or start of output.

claims.supporting_quote: No decisions have been made on whether to invest, how much to spend or when output would begin.

claims.claim: TSMC said it stays focused on its core business at all times and on being the trusted technology and capacity provider of logic chips.

claims.supporting_quote: TSMC said it stays "focused on our core business at all times" and remains dedicated to fabricating chips designed by other companies.

claims.claim: Counterpoint Research estimates global DRAM revenue in the third quarter of 2026 jumped 369 percent year on year, with Samsung at 38 percent, SK hynix at 29 percent, Micron at 21 percent, and CXMT at 9 percent.
claims.episode_span: global DRAM revenue in the third quarter of 2026 up 369 percent year on year
claims.source_title: Nvidia Taps TSMC to Build 3D DRAM, Threatening to Reshuffle Memory Supply Chain
claims.supporting_quote: Counterpoint Research estimates that global DRAM revenue in the third quarter of 2026 jumped 369% from a year earlier; by revenue share, Samsung held 38%, SK hynix 29% and Micron 21%, for a combined 88%, while China's CXMT accounted for 9%.

claims.claim: TrendForce forecasts conventional DRAM contract prices will rise another 10 to 15 percent quarter on quarter in the fourth quarter.

claims.supporting_quote: TrendForce also forecasts that conventional DRAM contract prices will rise another 10% to 15% quarter-on-quarter in the fourth quarter.

claims.claim: Micron has decided not to bring 4F² DRAM to market and is pursuing 3D DRAM.

claims.supporting_quote: Micron has decided not to bring 4F² DRAM to market, even though it claims to have invented the cell design and has been researching it for around two decades, opting instead for the path to 3D DRAM.
